claims.text: Some clinicians give a single glucocorticoid dose (eg, dexamethasone 10 mg IM); may shorten Sx w.o changing relapse or adverse-effect rates.
claims.quote: Some clinicians also give a single dose of a glucocorticoid (eg, dexamethasone 10 mg IM), which may help shorten symptom duration without affecting rates of relapse or adverse effects
Some clinicians do not use glucocorticoids because of their adverse effects.

claims.text: IDSA: ⍉routine adjunctive corticosteroids for GAS pharyngitis
claims.quote: Currently, the IDSA does not recommend routine adjunctive therapy with corticosteroids for those with GAS pharyngitis.
